issue: NovelAI Diffusion V5 and V5 Full inpainting are absent from the Krita plugin

before.reproduction: Connect the NovelAI backend and open the NovelAI style model selector, then attempt text generation or selected-region inpainting with a V5 model.
before.expected: V5 Curated and V5 Full are selectable; V5 Full inpainting uses nai-diffusion-5-full-inpainting; V5 Curated inpainting follows the official temporary fallback to nai-diffusion-4-5-curated-inpainting; unsupported V5 references are not sent or encoded.
before.actual: The built-in model registry ends at V4.5, no V5 styles exist, and manually supplied V5 Curated would be routed to the unavailable nai-diffusion-5-curated-inpainting model while Vibe could incur an unsupported encode-vibe request.

adjacent_working_case: V4.5 Curated and Full generation, img2img, inpainting, Vibe Transfer, and Precise Reference must retain their existing request behavior.
hypothesis: Adding the production V5 model identifiers and model-specific capability/routing rules at the NAI request boundary is sufficient to expose V5 without changing the established V4.5 path.
disproof: The hypothesis is false if V5 requests require an undocumented endpoint or incompatible payload, if V5 Curated infill selects its unavailable V5 inpainting identifier, if a V5 Vibe control reaches encode-vibe, or if V4.5 request contracts change.
